pricing.faq.q1: What's the difference between PRO and Free?
pricing.faq.a1: PRO removes all ads and provides unlimited time zone reminders, unlimited meeting participants, team clocks, custom city lists, data export, dark theme, and higher API rate limits. The Free version can be used forever with basic features but has ads and quantity limits.
pricing.faq.a2: Absolutely. PRO is a monthly subscription. You can cancel at any time, and you'll still enjoy all PRO benefits for the remainder of the current billing period. No automatic charges for the next period.
pricing.faq.a3: Yes. If you need a team subscription for 5+ people, contact us for a team discount. Email: support@globetimezone.com.
pricing.faq.q4: Is my data safe? Will my query history be collected?
pricing.faq.a4: GlobeTimeZone does not collect your time zone query history. We use Cloudflare's global CDN for acceleration, and your data is completely anonymous. PRO users' export features are entirely under your control.
pricing.faq.a5: Yes. Annual billing is $39.99/year, equivalent to $3.33/month — about 16% savings compared to monthly. You'll get full PRO access immediately upon subscription.

privacy.s1.p1: When you visit our website, we automatically collect the following anonymous usage data:
privacy.s1.p2: This data is used solely for service quality analysis and security protection, and will not be linked to any personal identity information.
privacy.s1.li1: IP address (anonymized, only the first two bytes are retained for geolocation)
privacy.s1.li3: Page visit records (which pages were visited, duration of stay)
privacy.s1.li4: Essential Cookies: Used to ensure basic website functionality (such as maintaining session state)
privacy.s1.p3: When you register as a PRO member, we additionally collect the following data to provide value-added services:
privacy.s1.li5: Email address: Used for identity verification, guarantee application processing, and service notifications
privacy.s1.li6: API call timestamps: Used for quota management and service optimization
privacy.s1.li7: Time zone preferences: Used for personalized time display
privacy.s1.li8: NTP calibration status query records: Used for credibility assessment and improvement
privacy.s1.li9: Personal identity information (name, address, phone number)
privacy.s1.li10: Payment information (all payments are processed independently by Stripe; we cannot access your credit card number or bank account)
privacy.s1.li11: Browser fingerprint or device unique identifiers
privacy.s2.li1: Provide, maintain, and improve our NTP-calibrated time service
privacy.s2.li2: Send service-related necessary notifications to PRO users (such as quota usage reminders, guarantee application results)
privacy.s2.li3: Analyze and monitor service performance, prevent fraud and abuse
privacy.s2.li4: Comply with applicable laws and regulations
privacy.s2.p1: We will not use your data for: targeted advertising, user profiling, or selling to third parties.
privacy.s3.p1: All data is stored in the Cloudflare global edge network, utilizing its built-in encrypted storage mechanisms. Data is retained during the account's active period. Upon account deletion, all associated data will be automatically removed from the system within 30 days.
privacy.s4.p1: Our service is provided through the Cloudflare global network, which means your data may be transmitted between servers located in different countries or regions. We have implemented appropriate security measures (including end-to-end encryption) to protect your data. By using this service, you understand and agree to this cross-border data transfer arrangement.
privacy.s5.p1: Regardless of your country or region, you have the following rights:
privacy.s5.li1: Right of access: Request to review the personal data we hold about you
privacy.s5.li2: Right to rectification: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
privacy.s5.li3: Right to data portability: Request export of your data in a structured, commonly used format
privacy.s5.li4: Right to erasure: Request deletion of your personal data that we hold
privacy.s5.p2: To exercise any of the above rights, please send an email to privacy@globetimezone.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacy.s6.p1: We only use essential Cookies to ensure basic website functionality (such as remembering your language preference). We do not use any tracking cookies, third-party advertising cookies, or analytics cookies. You can reject or delete cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.s7.p1: Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California residents have the following additional rights:
privacy.s7.li1: Request disclosure of the categories and specific content of personal information we have collected in the past 12 months
privacy.s7.li2: Request deletion of your personal information we have collected (except as otherwise required by law)
privacy.s7.li3: Opt out of the sale of your personal information (We confirm: we do not sell any personal information)
privacy.s7.li4: Not be subject to discriminatory treatment when exercising CCPA rights
privacy.s8.p1: If you have any questions, comments, or complaints about this privacy policy, please contact us through the following methods:
privacy.s8.p2: We will respond to your email as soon as possible, typically within 5 business days.
